name: BEST Papas Con Rajas Recipe (Mexican Potatoes With Roasted Poblano Peppers)
steps: Roast the poblano peppers then remove charred bits, stem, and seeds. Slice into thin strips. Sauté the onion until soft then add the garlic and potatoes with the seasonings. Cook until soft then add the poblano pepper strips and warm through then sever.
